summary: NFSv4 lets a client open a file and also receive a delegation, which gives it the right to cache information about that file locally. This RFC adds several extensions to NFSv4.2 for opening files and delegating them to clients, making those operations more flexible and efficient.

eli5.summary: When you borrow a book from a library, the librarian may let you keep it a while without checking in. This adds smarter ways to borrow files on a network and keep a local copy.

questions: how to open and delegate a file in nfs
